question: Can an unguarded direct semantic ray move be legally emitted on fresh roots and enter the existing static movement-price projection?
changed_premise: A preceding fresh-root direct-leap screen demonstrated one statically projectable geometry family. This independent screen tests the analogous bounded ray family; it does not revisit the guarded auxiliary-action case.
selection: Per seed, deterministically choose one generated non-promotable type present on the initial board, with emitted movement atoms and no existing RayAtom((1,0),*); never resample a seed if no type qualifies.
template: augment with owner-relative ray direction (1,0), min_steps=1, max_steps=3, empty target, one move(source,target) effect and own_anchor_safe invariant; no guards, auxiliary slots or other effects.
measurements: static profile projection contains the new bounded ray
legacy-versus-semantic board price values for selected type
interpretation: A positive result establishes only a scoped legal, statically projectable template on the fixed roots; a negative result remains root/template-specific. It is not evidence of value calibration or full generator coverage.
